To

All Additional CPFCs (Zones)

(Through official website)
Subject- Banking Arrangement regarding payment to International

Workers.
Sir,

As you are aware that consequent upon introduction of Special Provisions in respect
of International Workers (IWs) included in the Employees’ Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 as
well as Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995, India has signed Social Security Agreements
(SSAs) with eleven countries, out of which SSAs in respect of five countries have been given
effect so far. As per the terms and conditions of SSAs, the EPFO is required to make
payment of social security benefits to the [Ws in their home countries. Accordingly for this
purpose, a banking arrangement is being negotiated, for which the following information is
required urgently;

(i) The total number of foreign national pensioners as on date
(ii) The amount paid to each foreign national pensioner during the last 12 calendar
months

(iii) The mode of pension payment to foreign national retirees

2. You are, therefore, requested to kindly arrange to send the requisite information to IW
Unit by 28.09.2011 positively

Yours faithfully,
dt
(Udita Chowdhary)
